meta.name: arboreto
meta.description: Infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from gene expression data using scalable algorithms (GRNBoost2, GENIE3). Use when analyzing transcriptomics data (bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq) to identify transcription factor-target gene relationships and regulatory interactions. Supports distributed computation for large-scale datasets.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 识别转录因子与靶基因的调控关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有转录组数据,想找到基因间的调控网络
copy.tagline_en: Identify regulatory relationships between transcription factors and target genes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have transcriptomics data and want to uncover gene regulatory networks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 arboreto 从基因表达数据推断基因调控网络,产出含转录因子、靶基因和重要性分数的表格,并可按转录因子名单筛选或过滤高置信度链接。
howto.when: 当你分析转录组数据(如 bulk RNA-seq、单细胞 RNA-seq)并想找出转录因子与靶基因的调控关系时触发。

say.text: 用 GRNBoost2 从这份表达矩阵推断基因调控网络
say.note: 输出 TF、target、importance 三列表格

say.text: 把 importance 大于 0.5 的调控链接筛出来保存
say.note: 只留下高置信度的调控关系

howto.what_en: Arboreto infers gene regulatory networks from expression data, returning a table of transcription factor, target gene and importance score; it can restrict to a TF list or filter by an importance threshold.
howto.when_en: Use when analyzing transcriptomics data such as bulk or single-cell RNA-seq to identify transcription factor-target gene regulatory interactions.

say_en.text: Infer a gene regulatory network from this expression matrix with GRNBoost2
say_en.note: Returns a TF, target, importance table

say_en.text: Keep only links with importance above 0.5 and save them
say_en.note: Writes high-confidence links to a file

say_en.text: Rerun with seed 777 and compare the networks
